recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-26357 unless Pharmacy separately decides to retire the now-unbound historical MedicationKnowledge package-type value set or move that terminology maintenance into another workstream.
issue_request: FHIR-26357 was a Published/Persuasive R5 Pharmacy change request to fix the MedicationKnowledge package type terminology QA issue by binding to, or otherwise using, SNOMED CT Unit of Presentation SCTID 732935002 instead of maintaining a local value set/code system with undefined codes.
initial_application: Commit 519614a7a9adc064d66931e3a5e48a81478c2d1c applied the issue by changing source/medicationknowledge/valueset-medicationknowledge-package-type.xml from the local terminology.hl7.org medicationknowledge-package-type CodeSystem include to a SNOMED CT compose include using filter concept is-a 732935002, and by removing the old CodeSystem valueSet back-reference that caused the build error.
additional_context: MedicationKnowledge is active in source/fhir.ini. The current value set still has the SNOMED CT Unit of Presentation name, title, description, copyright, and 732935002 filter. Later MedicationKnowledge packaging work removed MedicationKnowledge.packaging.type from the current resource and replaced the detailed package definition with MedicationKnowledge.packaging.packagedProduct referencing PackagedProductDefinition; the related FHIR-26536 audit is already on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the requested SNOMED CT value-set change is present and there is no remaining current MedicationKnowledge packaging.type binding to repair.
